title: Participles 4: Passive Past Long Form - the -нный and -тый Families
titleRussian: Причастия 4: страдательные прошедшего времени (полная форма) - семьи -нный и -тый
description: The passive past participle in its long (attributive) form, for the two mechanical families: -нный from perfective -ать / -ять verbs (прочитанный, написанный) and -тый from monosyllabic stems and -ыть / -оть verbs (открытый, начатый). The -ить family comes in lesson 5.
descriptionRussian: Страдательное причастие прошедшего времени в полной форме для двух «механических» семей: -нный от глаголов совершенного вида на -ать / -ять (прочитанный, написанный) и -тый от односложных основ и глаголов на -ыть / -оть (открытый, начатый). Семья на -ить - в уроке 5.
intro: This is the one you will actually use. It says something has been done to the noun and is finished, which covers an enormous amount of ordinary Russian. Two families here, sorted by the shape of the verb, and both are predictable. A third family is large enough to get its own lesson next. Watch the doubled consonant: it marks this form as the one that sits with a noun.
rules: A passive past participle says the noun has been completely acted upon at some prior moment: a written letter → написанное письмо. The long form is attributive (sits with the noun); the short form (lesson 6) is predicative.
Family 1: perfective verbs in -ать / -ять drop -ть and take -нн- + adjective endings. Прочитать → прочитанный; написать → написанный; потерять → потерянный.
Family 2: monosyllabic stems and verbs in -ыть / -оть take -т- + adjective endings. Открыть → открытый; забыть → забытый; начать → начатый; взять → взятый.
The doubled -нн- (or -т-) marks the long form. A single -н- belongs to the short form (lesson 6); for an attribute, use the doubled spelling.
Two restrictions: only perfective verbs and only transitive verbs form a passive past participle. The -ить family (-енн- / -ённ-) is taught in lesson 5.
examples: Прочитанная статья лежала на столе. (The article that had been read lay on the table.)

tables.title: Three formation families for the passive past long form

items.prompt: Recap from L3: what is the passive present participle of читать?
items.promptEnglish: Form the passive present participle of читать.
items.hint: Recap: take the 'we' form (читаем) and add -ый.
items.explanation: Recap from L3: читаем + ый = читаемый (passive PRESENT: being read right now). Today's lesson covers the passive PAST form (прочитанный), the completed prior action. Читавший is the active past (L2); читающий is the active present (L1).

items.prompt: What is the passive past long-form participle of прочитать?
items.promptEnglish: Form the passive past long-form participle of прочитать.
items.hint: Прочитать ends in -ать; drop -ть and add -нн- + adjective ending.
items.explanation: Прочита- + нн + ый = прочитанный (the book / article that has been read). The doubled -нн- marks the long form. Прочитавший is the active past participle (the reader); прочитаемый is not standard (perfective verbs do not form passive PRESENT participles); прочитан is the SHORT form, covered in lesson 5.

items.prompt: What is the passive past long-form participle of написать?
items.promptEnglish: Form the passive past long-form participle of написать.
items.hint: Написать ends in -ать; the -ать family takes -нн-, not -т-.
items.explanation: Написа- + нн + ый = написанный (the written letter). The -ать family always takes -нн-, never -т-. Написавший is the active past; написаный with a single -н- is the short-form spelling, wrong for an attribute; написатый wrongly applies the -т- pattern (which belongs to -ыть / -оть / monosyllabic stems).

items.prompt: What is the passive past long-form participle of открыть?
items.promptEnglish: Form the passive past long-form participle of открыть.
items.hint: Открыть has a monosyllabic stem ending in -ыть. Which suffix family does it take?
items.explanation: Откры- + т + ый = открытый (open; opened). Verbs in -ыть belong to the -т- family; their passive past participle takes a single -т-, not -нн-. Открывший is the active past participle (the opener); открытанный and открыванный are learner overgeneralizations that apply -нн- to a stem that requires -т-.

items.prompt: What is the passive past long-form participle of решить?
items.promptEnglish: Form the passive past long-form participle of решить (stress falls on the suffix in the perfective).
items.hint: Решить is in the -ить family. The 1st person singular is решу́, with stress on the ending. Which suffix variant fits?
items.explanation: Решить has stress on the suffix throughout its perfective forms (решу́, реши́т), so the suffix surfaces as the stressed -ённ- (with -ё-). Реш- + ённ + ый = решённый (solved). Решавший is the active past participle of imperfective решать (the aspect partner); решающий is the active present of решать; решая is the imperfective gerund (verbal-adverbs track), not a participle at all.

items.prompt: Прочитавший студент vs Прочитанный учебник: who or what is acting in each?
items.promptEnglish: Identify which form is active and which is passive.
options: Both are active; both have the student as actor
Both are passive; both have something acting on the noun
Прочитавший is active (the student reads); Прочитанный is passive (someone reads the textbook)
Прочитавший is passive; Прочитанный is active
items.answer: Прочитавший is active (the student reads); Прочитанный is passive (someone reads the textbook)
items.hint: Active = the noun performs the action. Passive = the noun is acted upon.
items.explanation: Прочитавший is the ACTIVE past participle: the student is the reader, the one performing the action. Прочитанный is the PASSIVE past participle: the textbook is the patient, the thing being read. Same root verb (прочитать), same past tense, different voice: the form choice is decided by which side of the action the noun sits on.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Passive past long form, feminine singular: the article is the patient (it has been read); agrees with the feminine noun статья.
hints: The article is the thing READ, not the reader. Which voice fits, and which tense (a finished prior action)?
explanations: Прочитанная is the passive past long form, feminine singular, agreeing with the feminine noun статья. The article is the patient (it has been completely read); the form fits both restrictions (passive voice + completed past action). Прочитавшая is the active past feminine ('a woman who had read'); читающая is the active present ('a woman who is reading'); читавшая is the active past imperfective ('a woman who used to read').

errorCorrection.explanation: The attributive long form from an -ать verb takes the doubled -нн-: сдела- + нн + ый = сделанный. A single -н- is the SHORT form's spelling (сделан), not the long form, so сделаный is the classic misspelling. Сделавший is the active participle.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The opened door creaked in the wind.
errorCorrection.explanation: Открыть belongs to the -т- family, so its long passive past is открытая, not a -нн- form. Открынная wrongly applies the -нн- suffix that belongs to -ать verbs; verbs in -ыть take -т-. Открывшая is the active past; открыта is the short feminine form, predicative, which cannot sit as an attribute before дверь.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The car bought yesterday has already broken down.
errorCorrection.explanation: Купить has a labial stem (п), so the passive past inserts -л- before the suffix: купленная, the same -л- you hear in the 1sg куплю. Dropping it gives купенная, a very common learner error on labial-stem verbs. The stress sits on the stem (ку́пленная), so the suffix is -е-, not -ё-: куплённая is wrong. Купившая is the active past ('a woman who had bought'), not the passive 'bought'.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The book that has already been read lies on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Уже' marks the reading as finished before now, which is the passive PAST long form: уже прочитанная книга. Читаемая is the passive PRESENT ('being read right now'), and 'уже читаемая' contradicts itself.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The read article lay on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: Both are past participles of прочитать, but the voice differs. Прочитанная is PASSIVE (the article has been read; it is the patient). Прочитавшая is ACTIVE (the article had read something). An article cannot be the reader, so the passive form is correct.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each perfective verb by which passive past long-form suffix it takes.

reviewVocab.definition: passive past participle (the noun has been acted upon at a prior moment; only perfective transitive verbs form one)
reviewVocab.example: Прочитанный, написанный, открытый, начатый — это страдательные причастия прошедшего времени.

reviewVocab.definition: long form (the attributive form, which agrees in gender, number, and case; the short form, lesson 5, is predicative)
reviewVocab.example: Прочитанная книга — полная форма; в предложении 'Книга прочитана' стоит краткая форма.

reviewVocab.definition: the -нн- suffix (the most common formation, used for perfective -ать / -ять verbs; the doubled -нн- is the long-form hallmark)
reviewVocab.example: Прочита- + нн + ый = прочитанный; написа- + нн + ый = написанный.

reviewVocab.definition: stress (the placement of stress decides between -енн- and -ённ- in the -ить family; -ё- only appears under stress)
